name: Vesna
subtitle: The Seer
description: Neither goddess nor mortal, Vesna the oracle dwells in Vyraj’s mountain peaks, descending to revel in the spring and bless the youths of the community. Vesna sees Ryven as a new beginning—a new spring—and works to inspire the younger generation to become the focus of society, unconcerned with the knowledge and wisdom of the elders that might be lost.
